newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE -- Pointe Coupee Parish, La..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE -- Pointe Coupee Parish, La..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Police Jury of the Pointe Coupee, State of Louisiana, acting as the governing
authority thereof, will receive sealed bids for the purchase of $6,600,000 Road Improvement Bonds, Series ST-1997A of the Parish of Pointe Coupee, State of Louisiana (the
at its regular meeting place, the Courthouse Annex, New Roads, Louisiana, until SIX O'CLOCK (6:00) P.M., DAYLIGHT SAVINGS TIME, on

The Bonds will be in fully registered form, will be dated September 1, 1997, will be in the denomination of $5,000 each or any integral multiple thereof for any single maturity, will bear interest from date thereof or the most recent interest payment date to which interest has been paid or duly provided for at a rate or rates not exceeding eight percent (8%) per annum on any Bond in any interest payment period, said interest to be payable March 1, 1998 and semi- annually thereafter on September 1 and March 1 of each year. The Bonds will be numbered from R-1 upward and will mature serially on September 1 of each as follows, to-wit:

Those Bonds maturing September 1, 2003 and thereafter will be callable for redemption by the Issuer in full at any time on or after September 1, 2002, or in part in the inverse order of their maturities, and if less than a full maturity then by lot within such maturity on any interest payment date on or after September 1, 2002 at the principal amount to be redeemed and accrued interest to the date fixed for redemption with redemption premiums expressed as a
percentage of the principal amount of each Bond redeemed, as follows:
In the event a Bond is of a denominations larger

$5,000, a portion of such Bond ($5,000 or any multiple thereof) may be redeemed. Official notice of such call of any Bonds for redemption will be given by first class mail, postage prepaid, by notice deposited in the United States mails not less than thirty (30) days prior to the redemption date addressed to the registered owner of each bond to be redeemed at his address as shown on the registration books of the Paying Agent. The Bonds are secured by and payable from the avails or proceeds of a 1/2 of 1% sales tax and a reserve fund, as more fully described in the Official Notice of Bond Sale. For information relative to the Bonds and not contained in the Published Notice of Bond Sale or for copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, contact David E. Cifreo, Secretary-Treasurer, Parish of Pointe Coupee, Louisiana, Post Office Box 290, New Roads, Louisiana 70760, telephone (504) 638-9556, or Fred G. Benton, Jr., Benton, Benton & Benton P.L.C., Bond Counsel, 601 St. Ferdinand Street, Baton Rouge, Louisiana 70802, telephone (504) 343-6611. THUS DONE AND SIGNED at New Roads, Louisiana, on this, the 25th day of June, 1997.
